title: Classification
description: Descriptive, non-exclusive classification. Multiple architectures/functions/tags may apply simultaneously; none of these values gate which structural fields (bodies/joints/constraints/...) are usable.

name.description: A human-readable name for this classification (e.g. "Stewart Platform").

architecture.description: Extensible; a composite mechanism may list multiple architectures (e.g. ["parallel", "serial"]).
